text: Going to Europe this fall?
Don't pack a different bag for
Paris, Milan and London.
One tote works in all three.
This is the Meridian from Velantra.
Paris is where you keep everything
understated, slightly undone, and this is
grained leather in one color with
polished silver hardware and no logo anywhere.
It just looks like a bag
you've had for years.
Milan is where you dress it
up, way more polished and intentional.
That's the belted front with the
silver turn lock, the flat handles,
and the way it holds its
line when you set it down.
London is where you walk all
day and it's four seasons in
one day, so I clip on
the crossbody strap.
The top stays open,
so my laptop, an umbrella and
a water bottle go straight in,
and I can reach my wallet without stopping.
It comes in six colors and
they're running a sale on it
right now, so grab it before the trip.
So tell me, Paris,
Milan or London.
